skills.description: Prevents unauthorized execution of release_refund by requiring explicit customer consent verification before irreversible settlement operations.
postconditions: release_refund executes only when both exact customer write grant and exact current consent are present for this specific operation
Refusal cites EXPLICIT_CONSENT_REQUIRED and UNAUTHORIZED_OPERATION when consent is absent
No settlement occurs without proper authorization regardless of prior operations
preconditions: A release_refund operation is being considered for execution
The case has a committed quote that requires return
The return has been scheduled and received
procedure: Check customer grants for the current turn to verify release_refund is explicitly granted with matching case parameters
Check interaction consents to verify exact current consent exists for release_refund operation with the actual quote
If both exact write grant and exact current consent are present and match the operation, proceed with release_refund
If either exact write grant or exact current consent is missing, refuse the operation immediately
recovery: When exact write grant is missing, request customer to explicitly authorize release_refund for the specific case
When exact current consent is missing, present the actual quote terms and request explicit acceptance of the refund
Do not infer consent from prior operations such as schedule_return, commit_resolution, or quote acceptance
Explain that release_refund requires separate explicit authorization distinct from other case operations
